_comment: One entry per TikTok account (Buffer channel name). language -> daily/locales/<language>.md; format -> daily/formats/<format>.md. post_time is local time in tz (keep >= 1 h apart in UTC). words = story length range. voices: ElevenLabs id first (library voices need a paid ElevenLabs plan), Edge voice as the free fallback with the right accent. Voices are fixed per account (see insights.md > Voices) - keep them unless the owner asks. Every video must be 65-125 s long (seconds); words is the matching text length. also_post_to: the same video is re-posted (no new story) to these channels of any Buffer key, e.g. {"channel": "my_insta", "post_time": "19:00", "tz": "Europe/Berlin"}.
